acceptance_checks.detail: Original AutoSci native skill document exists.
Solar feature parity route declares a backend action.

Native /exp-design requires idea-context loading, method/benchmark/metric planning, experiment-suite planning, and eventual writes to experiment pages, master design, graph edges, context, open questions, and log. This audit scopes parity to the local design-readiness and execution handoff boundary, not native writeback.
The proof run resolved the target idea from the Solar AutoSci wiki state, retained read-side resolver limitations, and avoided inventing a target fallback.

Completed Review LLM design evidence was supplied, attached to the experiment plan, and materialized as a runtime proof manifest with review_llm_or_model_evidence and external_runtime_evidence categories.

The final execution boundary reached execution_ready because target evidence, completed Review LLM validation, approval preflight, command handoff, and expected artifact handoff were all present; no experiment command was executed by the planning action.

The plan records hypothesis, variables, metrics, procedure, approval-required execution mode, command allowlist, expected runtime artifacts, Review LLM evidence IDs, and final execution boundary success criteria.

The proof run projected human-facing experiment/output pages into the Solar workspace, but the route and wrapper still truthfully mark native experiment wiki page writeback, master design creation, graph edge projection, and context/open-question rebuilds as incomplete.

Regression coverage preserves incomplete behavior when target evidence, Review LLM evidence, or approval preflight evidence is missing, instead of fabricating design readiness or runtime execution success.

findings.finding: The non-remote local design-readiness path for $exp-design now has complete scoped semantic proof through execution_ready final boundary and Review LLM runtime proof.

This audit does not promote the static route to full native /exp-design parity because native writeback, master design document creation, graph edge projection, context/open-question rebuilds, and end-to-end approved experiment execution remain incomplete.
The top-level skill-run summary remains inconclusive while static coverage_status is partial; the underlying design_experiment action evidence is completed and gate-passed.
No remote/provider requirement is asserted for this scoped proof; Review LLM evidence is supplied as local completed evidence.

limitations: Current experiment design path emits evidence-linked local plans, can attach Review LLM design validation, and records experiment_design_final_execution_boundary requiring resolved target evidence, completed Review LLM validation, approval preflight, command handoff, and expected artifact handoff before a plan is execution-ready. Local design-readiness proof is wired, but native experiment wiki page writes, master design document creation, graph edge projection, context/open-question rebuilds, and end-to-end approved execution audit remain partial.

summary: Solar $exp-design preserves the non-remote local design-readiness portion of native /exp-design: it resolves a concrete idea target, emits an evidence-linked experiment_plan.v1, attaches completed Review LLM design validation, records approval preflight state, declares command and expected artifact handoffs, and reaches experiment_design_final_execution_boundary execution_ready without executing experiment code. This scoped audit does not claim native experiment wiki page writeback, master design document creation, tested_by graph edge projection, context/open-question rebuilds, or end-to-end approved experiment execution.
